purpose: Recover authority when a prior durable owner is stale without duplicating substantive work. Under the active rolling runtime, normal completion-relative wake is reconstruction/continuation, while abrupt owner loss is a separate recovery class.
normal_path: On a valid same-canonical rolling wake after a committed normal close, verify newest schedule generation, provisionally rearm, reconstruct exact durable checkpoint, then claim a fresh authority epoch. Do not require a clock-bound handoff request.

NORMAL_COMMITTED_CONTINUATION.rationale: A committed predecessor close plus verified successor schedule is intentional continuation, not failure recovery.

ABRUPT_OWNER_LOSS.rationale: Uncommitted disappearance requires fencing before takeover; optimize independently from normal scheduler delivery.

already_stale_fast_path.rationale: Do not add a second 120-second idle tax when predecessor was already stale for the full recovery grace.

legacy_note: Version 2 request/ack wording reflected the retired fixed-quarter rolling-worker design. Historical evidence remains valid; active recovery semantics follow rolling completion-relative lifecycle.
